## Summary
Built an end-to-end data pipeline using Python and Snowflake to extract, stage, transform, and analyze data from diverse sources (CSV, XML, PostgreSQL, Cybersyn NOAA).

[Download Codebook (.ipynb)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/106sWGznJksgdVveoFmI01F9Z4F_WcjK4/view?usp=share_link)

## Key Insights
- Enabled clear identification of invoice discrepancies between purchase orders and billed amounts.
- Found no direct correlation between extreme weather conditions and billing discrepancies; however, the pipeline facilitates future, deeper analysis.
- Optimized performance by conducting transformations directly within Snowflake using SQL rather than Python scripts.

## Technical Highlights
- Automated complex data integration from multiple formats into a centralized warehouse.
- Achieved efficiency through Snowflake's bulk loading features (COPY INTO).

## Tools & Techniques
Python, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, SQL transformations
